description: Send the trusted-device approval for a sealed draft to the user's phone and return its approval_session_id. Tell the user to answer on their phone within ~5 minutes. Do NOT call commit_transfer yet: when the user says they have answered, call approval_session_get_approval_session_status with the approval_session_id, and commit only once it returns APPROVED.
name: request_transfer_approval
title: Request Transfer Approval
